text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, looking good, Espo-san! At this 
rate, the actual Fan Appreciation Day is 
going to be a total breeze.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Espo-san and my special unit, 
"Twin☆Golden"! It's definitely gonna be an 
awesome concert!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Of course! With my flashy performance, I'm 
gonna show everyone looking down on me 
what's what.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I went out of my way to team 
up with you! Listen up, we're giving it 
everything we've got!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"To think you'd get this serious about 
it...! Falco is deeply moved☆"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
In that case... Let's do a special 
training session together tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Special Training Part 1! "Run to the 
Top☆Umadol Road"! Singing while dashing 
all the way to the peak☆

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
All the way to the summit!? Wh-While 
singing...!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Stamina and singing ability are idol 
fundamentals! I've gotta train hard so I 
can handle any live performance!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
H-Hah! Bring it on, punk! Somethin' like 
that's a piece of cake for me!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~, nice, nice! Aim for the top and 
fight, oh☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Resonate, fanfare~♪ Reach all the way to 
the goal line~♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Special Training Part 2 is 
"Sparkle☆Splash"! We'll practice fan 
service while enduring that waterfall♪

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Haaaah?! Why the heck not?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Delivering 100% fan service no matter the 
situation. That's what being an Umadol is 
all about!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, are you tired out, perhaps...? If so, 
don't push yourself, you can rest—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Haaah?! Don't you look down on me! I'll 
take ya on, dammit!

—Even after that, the two continued their 
live concert lessons up in the 
mountains...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *gasp*...! That's gotta be... 
enough, right...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! That's true, but... I'm gonna 
keep practicing just a little longer!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Special Training Part 6, "Dynamic☆Umadol 
Step"! Until I can lightly dance through 
an entire song while carrying this log on 
my back...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Knock it off, you've got lessons 
tomorrow too, right?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Just a little is all I need! If I pull it 
off now, it'll help with my mental 
training once I get home!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If I just push a little harder here... I 
might be able to put a smile on all my 
fans' faces!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"For everyone who supports Falco, I want 
to put on a very special live at the Fan 
Thanksgiving Festival."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If it's for that... Falco can do 
absolutely anything!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco is an Umadol after all... I want to 
give my all to meet my fans' 
expectations!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Ghhh.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—Aaaargh! Fine, I get it! I'll come along 
too!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I ain't half-assing this either! Let's 
give the fans a concert they'll never 
forget!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Espo-san...! Yeah, let's make this the 
ultimate live concert☆

The day of the Fan Appreciation Festival. 
As I watched Smart Falcon and the others' 
live concert...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks for comin' out today~☆ Falco is so 
happy to see everyone!♪"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hah! You felt my spirit, didn't ya? ...Now 
you know who's the strongest, right!?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOH! Falco's the best~~!! Espo~! 
We'll always cheer for you!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, how about that huge cheer just now! 
I nailed it, didn't I!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! Falco and the others' 
concert... it really reached everyone's 
hearts, didn't it?

for the fans!
Maybe we should form an official unit.

lessons...!

didn't you...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, you think so? I mean, I *am* an 
Umadol, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Espo-san worked super hard for the fans 
too! Thank you so, so much☆

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! It's not like I'm doing it for the 
fans or anything.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that sounds great~! Espo-san, why not 
try being an Umadol for real?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I think she could totally pull off a cute 
look♪ Her tsundere side makes you just 
want to cheer her on!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hah!? Hell no, you idiot! Like I'd ever do 
something so out of character!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, maybe so! It was a bit of a tough 
lesson, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hah!? ...*That* was just a little...!?
